# Issue #195 report

Revised the saved [generator](../benchmark/scripts/challenges.py) to use two 12-ID library cases and the three-ID unsupported VI case.
Generated 33 controls with materialized submissions, exact synthetic raw responses, evidence pointers, fixed denominators and per-ID expectations.
Positive submissions include every required ID; unavailable native answers remain null without fabricated citations.
Matching reader observations remain unverified because native references are unavailable.
The generated [README](../benchmark/challenges/README.md) maps every protocol challenge row, including explicit computation, typedef-impact and native-evidence gaps.
Removed the two obsolete large-case fixtures and pinned the generator, README, three fixtures and preparation status in [preparation.json](../benchmark/preparation.json).
Set challenges to `prepared-not-reviewed` and refreshed every preparation-status SHA256 pin across milestones.
The issue Verification command exited **0**; evaluator errors were empty and `challenges` was absent from its missing list.
Evaluator missing milestones were **`split`, `baseline`**, rather than only `baseline`.
Checked all 33 controls and 1,080 required ledger slots, raw-response hashes and identical constant-export bytes.
Six isolated trials confirmed `--check` rejects missing/different README and extra files/directories/symlinks without writing; `git diff --check` passed.
No reader, native comparison or scorer was executed; these remain public preparation fixtures pending independent review.

## Discoveries
The pre-existing `split` milestone remains empty in [preparation.json](../benchmark/preparation.json), preventing the goal's baseline-only missing list.

## What next
Request independent review of the pinned fixtures and original locators, then a separately ordered scorer; resolve `split` through its own preparation task.
Resume from the generated fixtures and passing checks; avoid repeating startup reads, printing whole inventories, or treating synthetic inputs as execution evidence.
